nws_afd.quote: The thin marine layer gave it one last try this morning, with foggy conditions within 5 miles of the coastline. High pressure aloft will subtly strengthen into the weekend, causing the marine layer to thin even further with mainly clear skies going forward each night.

alerts.headline: Extreme Heat Warning issued October 2 at 9:13PM PDT until October 8 at 8:00PM PDT by NWS San Diego CA
alerts.description:
* WHAT...Dangerously hot conditions with high temperatures ranging
from the mid 80s to around 90 near the coast to the mid 90s to
around 100 near higher coastal terrain expected. Nights will be
very warm with low temperatures mostly in the 70s.

* WHERE...Orange County Coastal Areas.

* WHEN...Until 8 PM PDT Thursday.

* IMPACTS...Heat related illnesses increase significantly during
extreme heat events.
